create_Trainer_optimizer: create an Adam optimizer for trainable modules using the Trainer get_optimizer method
save_Trainer_model: save a model snapshot excluding mano_layer weights using the Trainer save_model method
load_Trainer_model: load the latest model checkpoint and optimizer state using the Trainer load_model method
set_Trainer_lr: set the learning rate with step decay schedule using the Trainer set_lr method
run_Tester_evaluation: run model evaluation on test data using the Tester _evaluate and _print_eval_result methods
